authorized_evidence.content:
Approval Requirements

Employees must receive manager approval before changing their regular work location. A temporary change within the same country for fewer than 15 business days may be approved by the manager. Longer changes require People Operations review.

Managers should consider team coverage, customer needs, time zone overlap, and data handling requirements before approving remote work.

Employee Support Channels

General HR questions should be sent to People Operations. Benefits questions should be sent to the benefits support queue. Security access questions should be sent to IT Support. Performance or role expectation questions should first be discussed with the employee's manager.

Related Policies

For time off, consult the PTO and Leave Policy. For remote work, consult the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy. For acceptable technology use, consult the Acceptable Use Policy.

Privileged Access Review

Privileged access must be reviewed monthly for production systems and quarterly for business applications. Reviewers must confirm business need, manager approval, and least-privilege alignment.

Privileged access exceptions require an owner, expiration date, and documented business justification.

Deployment Approval

| Change Type | Required Review | Required Approver |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Documentation-only release | Peer review | Team lead |
| Low-risk application change | Peer review and automated tests | Team lead |
| Database migration | Peer review, rollback plan, staging proof | Engineering Manager |
| Security-sensitive change | Peer review, IT Admin review | Engineering Manager |
| Emergency hotfix | Incident commander review | Engineering Manager on call |

All production changes must include a rollback plan. A rollback plan that says "revert if needed" is not sufficient; it must name the specific revert, migration rollback, feature flag, or mitigation.

Access Notice

This document is restricted to IT/Admin users. It contains operational security guidance and must not be summarized for unauthorized roles.

Admin Account Handling

Admin accounts must be separate from normal user accounts. Admin access should use MFA, approved device posture, and session logging where supported.

This document does not contain passwords, tokens, secrets, or system credentials.

Storage Rules

Internal, Confidential, and Restricted data must be stored in approved company systems. Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should not be stored in local folders unless there is a documented business need.

Code of Conduct

Employees must communicate respectfully, protect confidential information, avoid harassment, and follow company security policies. Concerns about conduct should be reported to a manager, People Operations, or the confidential ethics channel.

The handbook does not include legal advice, salary bands, compensation formulas, or detailed HR investigation outcomes.

Retention Basics

Teams should retain records according to the retention schedule in their approved system. This public policy does not include detailed legal retention rules or HR investigation outcomes.
